title: Bid-Profile Supports
body_html:
Bid-Profile Supports

The basic auction layer includes support predicates for bid profiles and strategy profiles, including nonnegativity, membership in a product set, and membership in a rectangular box.

It also identifies bid-profile boxes with closed intervals.

References

  • [Krishna, Chapters 2-3] Vijay Krishna, Auction Theory, 2nd ed., references/AuctionTheory.pdf. Bid and valuation domains for standard sealed-bid auction models.
  • [AGT, Chapter 9, Sections 9.3-9.5] Nisan, Roughgarden, Tardos, and Vazirani, Algorithmic Game Theory, references/AlgorithmicGameTheory.pdf. Reports, strategy spaces, and payment mechanisms in direct mechanisms.

Provenance

  • Migrated from EconCSLib pull request 27, old blueprint label def:auction_basic_bid_support in blueprint/src/content.tex.
